meta_title: CoinPayments alternative — Dynopay non-custodial crypto checkout
meta_description: A modern CoinPayments alternative: Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway with a hosted checkout, auto-convert to USDT/USDC and funds straight to your wallet. No chargebacks. First payment free.
subheading: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins and 15+ assets with a clean hosted checkout — settled directly to a wallet you control, or auto-converted to USDC/USDT. No custodial wallet in between.
intro_paragraph: CoinPayments is one of the longest-running crypto processors, known for supporting a very large catalog of coins, a low flat fee, and its own integrated wallet. If maximum coin coverage and a built-in wallet are your priorities, CoinPayments delivers. Dynopay is built for merchants who prefer to hold their own funds and want a modern, conversion-focused checkout: payments settle on-chain straight to a wallet you control — never a processor-held balance — and you can auto-convert volatile coins to stablecoins the instant they confirm. You also get payment links, a product catalog, creator @handle tip pages, crowdfunding and a clean REST API with webhooks. Pricing starts at 1.5% with your first payment free and drops to 0.5% at scale, with no monthly or setup fees and zero chargebacks.

features.title: Funds land in your wallet, not a custodial balance
features.description: Unlike a processor-held wallet you later withdraw from, Dynopay settles every payment on-chain to an address you control. You keep custody and your private keys from the very first payment.

features.title: Auto-convert to stablecoin on settlement
features.description: Accept BTC or ETH and keep USDC or USDT instead — converted the moment the payment confirms and settled straight to your wallet, removing price-swing risk without a custodial step.

features.title: A checkout your customers actually finish
features.description: A hosted, mobile-first checkout with QR codes, coin and network switching and instant on-chain confirmation — designed for conversion, not just coin coverage.

features.title: More than a gateway
features.description: Payment links, a product catalog and storefront, creator tip pages, crowdfunding campaigns and a developer API with sandbox keys and webhooks — all in one place.

how_it_works: Create a free account and verify your email in under three minutes — no card, no crypto experience needed.
Add one payout wallet address per coin you want to accept. Dynopay is non-custodial, so payments go directly to you.
Share a payment link or embed the hosted checkout, then keep the coin or auto-convert to a stablecoin — settled to your wallet.

faqs.question: Is Dynopay a good CoinPayments alternative?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you want non-custodial settlement to your own wallet, optional auto-convert to stablecoins and a modern, conversion-focused checkout with storefront, creator and crowdfunding tools. CoinPayments may suit you better if you need the widest possible coin list or a built-in custodial wallet.

faqs.question: How do Dynopay and CoinPayments fees compare?
faqs.answer: CoinPayments is typically around 0.5% flat. Dynopay starts at 1.5% with your first payment free and tapers to 0.5% as your all-time settled volume grows. At low volume CoinPayments' flat rate is lower; Dynopay reaches parity at scale while settling funds directly to a wallet you control.

faqs.question: Is Dynopay non-custodial, unlike a built-in processor wallet?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is no Dynopay-held wallet or balance to withdraw from. Every payment settles on-chain straight to the wallet address you provide, so you never hand custody of your funds to the platform.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies does Dynopay support?
faqs.answer: 15+ assets across 9 blockchains — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, Bitcoin Cash and Polygon, plus USDT, USDC and RLUSD stablecoins. It's a focused list of the coins merchants actually get paid in rather than a catalog of thousands.

faqs.question: Can I migrate from CoinPayments to Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sign up, add your wallet address, and replace your CoinPayments checkout or buttons with a Dynopay payment link or hosted checkout. Most merchants are live in under 10 minutes.

cta_headline: Switch to a non-custodial crypto checkout
cta_body: First payment free, live in under 10 minutes. Keep your keys, auto-convert to stablecoin, and give customers a checkout they'll actually finish.
